status: synthetic proposal for independent review; no implementation or gate result
assumptions: No proposed worker, private endpoint or runtime decoder is implemented.
Case descriptions and private field spellings are review notation, not adopted wire DTOs.
Future executable tests must independently challenge expectations and record the implementation/runtime/resource tuple.
scope: R03/R12/R13/R15/R16; shared worker, controls, fairness and recovery

cases.setup: Sessions A and B assigned to one worker; independent managed pipe attempt C
expect: Both A/B interpretations become unavailable/unknown; service refuses new dependent admission and requests keeper input/reply fences, claiming an applied fence only after keeper acknowledgment
Independent observed C exit/stream/receipt facts remain attributed
Previously delivered A/B effects remain delivered or uncertain; no automatic replay
cases.forbid: Treating one multiplexed process as per-session fault isolation

cases.setup: Worker is unresponsive during large staged reset/snapshot/query flood
cases.fault: Human revoke/stop arrives while the parser cannot respond
cases.expect: Reserved service-to-keeper path admits controls independently of worker progress and reports actual fencing/termination/unreachable status
cases.forbid: Waiting for parser ack or recording a watchdog timeout as proof that effects stopped

cases.setup: Session A continuously ready with huge output/query/serialization work; B also ready
cases.fault: Repeated A work and slow output subscriber
expect: Charged bounded quanta yield while staged mutations stay private
B is not continuously bypassed; reserved control slots stay available
No parser bytes/committed control events disappear; slow presentation consumer gets explicit resync/disconnect
cases.forbid: Claiming measured latency/fairness from a count-only review matrix

cases.setup: Global/session queues, staged/snapshot copies and byte budgets near exhaustion
cases.fault: Another frame/session/copy reservation or reply flood
cases.expect: Admission/backpressure accounts all reserved bytes/copies before starting; bounded queues and reply reservations preserve core event commit rules
cases.forbid: Independent per-limit caps added up as guaranteed simultaneous capacity

cases.setup: Capture sink fails while canonical worker continues receiving every event
cases.fault: Storage full or capture write fails
cases.expect: Capture is gapped/unavailable; interpretation may remain current if canonical continuity is intact; refuse new evidence reservations and preserve pinned evidence
cases.forbid: Calling capture failure proof of parser loss or silently evicting pinned evidence

cases.setup: Canonical bytes/event identity lost or partial mutation cannot be classified
cases.fault: Gap, broken invariant or unsafe caught panic
cases.expect: Latch affected interpretation unknown, preserve last committed projection as stale, fence every application-input route; no guessed reset
cases.forbid: A plausible screen, catch_unwind or fresh UI connection restoring canonical authority

cases.setup: Capture off; worker owner remains alive; a frontend disconnects
cases.expect: Fresh presentation plus subsequent deltas at an identified cut; view remains read-only until fresh ownership granted
cases.forbid: Requiring durable byte replay or a complete snapshot solely to attach to a live owner

cases.setup: Capture off; canonical worker dies with no independently surviving complete authorized state/tail
cases.fault: Attempted recovery from cached presentation or app repaint
cases.expect: Interpretation remains unknown; process controls/status remain separately available; new session is an explicit option
cases.forbid: Restoring reduction from a visible frame, raw input bypass or reconstructing state from nothing

cases.setup: Authorized exact-version complete checkpoint plus gap-free ordered tail and independent receipt/delivery continuity
cases.fault: Restore/replay then fresh live ownership request
cases.expect: Validate every identity/profile/codec/quota/cut; replay with no external effects; reconcile keeper/receipts and create fresh authority before live input
cases.forbid: Re-emitting historical replies/launches/uncertain writes, rolling receipts back to a terminal snapshot or accepting missing/corrupt/oversized/incompatible state

cases.setup: Worker/service restarts or stale controller reconnects repeatedly
cases.fault: Late frame/reply/cancel result or restart storm
cases.expect: Retire old incarnation; reconcile explicit assignments/receipts; bound restart/backoff/resources without resurrecting queued grants
cases.forbid: A reused PID/session name or recovered token silently revives old authority

cases.setup: Service control audit storage exhausted but keeper is reachable
cases.expect: Future admission is fenced without waiting for a successful audit write; report persistence failure and independently observed remaining effects
cases.forbid: Full storage blocking human control or claiming durable audit success
